tools.name: add_contact

Use update_contact to change an existing contact, import_contacts or bulk_contacts for many. Returns the contact {id, email, status, tags, list_ids, ...}.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Add a custom domain to send and receive mail on, such as acme.com. tools.name: add_to_list
tools.description: Add contacts to a list. Returns {added: n} for newly added contacts. Errors: not_found (list or contact). Next: list_contacts with list_id to see members.

tools.name: bulk_contacts

tools.name: cancel_campaign

tools.name: create_event_definition
